learning_objective: 🎯 Enter the booming wellness industry! Learn about personal grooming, salon services, and fitness training that help people look and feel their best.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Grooming is the art of maintaining personal hygiene and a neat appearance. It includes basic habits like bathing, nail care, hair care, and wearing clean, ironed clothes.
Salons provide professional services to enhance appearance. This includes hairdressing, skincare (facials), manicures (hand care), pedicures (foot care), and makeup.
Wellness goes beyond just looks; it focuses on relaxing the mind and body. Services include massages, aromatherapy, and meditation techniques to reduce stress.
Fitness trainers and gym instructors help clients achieve their health goals. They design exercise routines, teach correct weightlifting techniques, and advise on diet.
In lifestyle services, 'how' you treat the client is just as important as the service itself. Good communication, politeness, and a welcoming smile are vital for success.

fun_activity.title: 🤝 The Polite Greeting
fun_activity.instructions: Pretend you are a salon manager and your sibling is a customer. Practice greeting them with a big smile, asking them to sit, and politely asking what service they need today. Soft skills matter!

exam_tips: 📌 Distinguish between grooming (basic hygiene/neatness) and salon services (professional beauty treatments).
📌 Soft skills (communication, politeness) are the backbone of the personal services industry.
📌 A fitness trainer must have a basic understanding of human anatomy and nutrition.
quick_recap: ⭐ The personal and lifestyle sector is one of the fastest-growing job markets globally.
⭐ Sterilization of tools (like scissors and combs) is mandatory in salons to prevent infections.
⭐ Wellness centers focus on both mental peace and physical relaxation.
